correctness.rationale: Uniform Fourier inversion uniquely determines all pre-collision weights; explicit Dirichlet sine/cosecant inequalities prove strict positivity for all odd sizes, including the continuous endpoint. Standalone checker executed with 1,226 finite assertions; analytical steps establish all-size quantifiers and include normalization and boundary cases.
